_comment: Google Play listing images, drawn by build.js (style B, chosen 2026-11-01). Each slide is one current design screen (design/canvas.html). `key` is the word in the title that gets the ring; `pop` is a card lifted out of the screen, as [x, y, w, h] in the screen's 390 x 844 dp; `chips` float round the phone; `covers` are saakhi covers fanned behind it. English only for now, and no caption quotes Gurbani (CLAUDE.md rule 3). A slide whose screen is superseded on the canvas changes with it.
